plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 188 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.13642, -126.35967, pull off on an unnamed gravel road. Map links below.
Walk: none. The spot is at the road.
Hunt: ducks, Jan, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Set up on the shore with the wind at your back: ducks land into the wind (Tip). Shoot only birds you can retrieve.
Use: 12 gauge, steel 2 to 4 (non toxic shot only), modified or improved cylinder rated for steel, plugged to 3 shells (regs).
Legal: MU (Management Unit) 1-14, Region 1. Season rows below. Study aid only. The official regulations are the law.
Verify: Candidate, scout it first. Check posted signs. Private land can be unsigned. Data dates: roads 2026-10-16, private land 2026-10-09, closures 2026-10-16.
R1D-duck-drive-0001.popWhy: Less popular (quieter): MU 1-14: about 269 hunter days a year for all big game (2020 to 2024 mean), 0.04 days per square km, bottom third of BC MUs; access: average access. Estimate, about 50% sure (my pick).

tags.label: Good solo
tags.why: Short pack out: 0.0 km and about 0 m of climb from the parking (Tip). Cell coverage is not in the data: leave a trip plan and carry SOS or a satellite messenger (lesson: Bush safety).

R1D-moose-walk-0004.pressureWhy: No town, pavement or rec site within 1 km and not behind a closure (estimate).

evidence.t: 4 wetlands within 2 km; nearest 0.3 ha, 1.2 km NW.
Cutblock harvested 2015 (11 years old), 850 m NW: browse.

seasonRows.notes: No row in the Region 1 table, so no general open season (page 5: open seasons are only those in the synopsis). Mountain quail: printed 'No open season on mountain quail'.

plan: Drive: from City of Campbell River, about 190 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate).
Park: 51.10762, -126.46443, pull off on Wakeman FSR (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk: 1.3 km SE, cross country, no trail mapped. Climb about 640 m, about 90 min at 3 km/h.
Hunt: moose, season: VERIFY. Glass the wetland and cutblock edges at dawn and dusk. Move slowly, stop often (Tip).
Use: .308 Winchester, 165 to 180 grain premium bullet, shots inside about 200 m (219 yd) (Tip).
